data.reasoning: The deepseek-v4-flash model successfully reviewed all package files and correctly identified standard, benign AUR packaging practices, including a pinned git source with checksums and routine build patches. The qwen3 model's 'inconclusive' verdict was solely due to LLM API failures (HTTP 400) preventing it from reviewing 4 out of 5 files, providing no actual security signal for those files.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is an artifact of a tool failure. The qwen3 model encountered HTTP 400 errors when attempting to audit the PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO, .nvchecker.toml, and Qt6GuiPrivate-fix.patch, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and found them safe.
coverage_issues: qwen3-235b failed to review PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO, .nvchecker.toml, and Qt6GuiPrivate-fix.patch due to LLM API HTTP 400 errors.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) to prevent partial audits from defaulting to inconclusive verdicts when the initial PKGBUILD parse succeeded.
Distinguish between 'inconclusive due to missing data/tool error' and 'inconclusive due to ambiguous code' in the final verdict reporting to avoid triggering unnecessary escalation audits.
